outcome: Finish Batch K with a clearly estimated cash outlook, evidence-based customer health, and protected downloadable year-end accounting evidence, without inventing receipts or tax facts.
risk: Forecast misrepresented as actual cash; lead/private financial data; tax/1099 classification without source proof; provider and CPA acceptance separated.
next: Complete K-8 exact-head CI/review/merge, then reconcile ordered roadmap and still-pending real-world acceptance.

references.purpose: K-7 immutable actual P&L reused for year-end.
Single metric catalog for real vs estimate.
Use existing template semantics; avoid double forecast.
Filing status/worksheet source, not assumed tax payable.

invariants: Historical actuals from verified posted records only
No customer/bank data exposed to STAFF
No money, tax filing, provider request or marketing messaging
No K-CASH implementation without independent approved card
sequence: Build bounded pure cash-flow recurrence and cent formatting
Build repeatable read source queries/health, year-end evidence
Build accessible protected owner report and CSV
Add pure, real-DB and browser security/correctness tests
acceptance: OWNER and ADMIN only can read cashForecast, customerHealth and yearEndPackage through current live database roles and authenticated routes. STAFF and CUSTOMER receive no business-level data, and all queries are read-only with bounded records and safe Colorado dates.

A 90-day configurable forecast (1–180 days) uses only ACTIVE agreements with successfully started recurring billing and a known real next billing date; monthly line totals reflect documented discounts/amendments and tax estimates use the existing Colorado tax calculation or are explicitly marked unknown pending missing tax context. Forecasted receipts are never described as bank cash or collected funds.

Recurring expense templates produce dated future estimated outflows once per template/cycle, with month-end day safety, and match already generated drafts to avoid double counting; speculative expenses are clearly labelled and never posted.

Open sales/use-tax filing periods contribute only supported worksheet amounts and known due dates. Missing/undecided worksheet, unconfirmed liability and unknown tax inputs are disclosed as needs-review entries, not invented payables. No filing, payment, provider call or tax estimate presented as confirmed.

Customer health distinguishes active, ending and ended agreements, rental lengths based on supported start/end dates and net collected receipts minus refunds/credit movements. Grouping by original lead source only when convertedCustomerId evidence exists, with an explicit unknown bucket; do not infer missing lead attribution.

Year-end accepts an actual, bounded YYYY with completed year or current year-to-date and owner Books opening-date guard. Downloadable deterministic safe CSVs include monthly P&L in separate accrual/cash bases, rental fixed-asset register with book depreciation and distinct CPA tax evidence status, sales and use-tax FILED periods by account, source-backed expenses by category, and supplier-paid summary for 1099-marked vendors at the owner-configured threshold.

Supplier-paid/1099 candidates are sourced only from confirmed, vendor-linked cash payments, not purchase orders, procurement receipts or unpaid expense drafts. Where purchase/expense supplier-payment matching cannot be proven, show unknown amounts or an explicit incomplete warning; do not fabricate income tax filing eligibility or claim federal threshold verification.

All actual/estimated customer, forecast and year-end metrics are registered in METRICS with date basis, calculation, exact sources and drill path. Phone-friendly OWNER/ADMIN screens, downloading links, clear warnings, safe CSV escaping and accessibility preserve existing Books navigation.

Pure math and disposable PostgreSQL tests cover role separation, future-cycle boundaries/DST, no billing-before-delivery, forecast-vs-real separation, incomplete worksheet, source-only collection/refund, lead-link gap, book CPA non-inference and 1099 evidence thresholds. Browser/axe and full exact-head CI/review pass; update roadmap/status/owner guide, decisions, database and go-live acceptance. Real-world CPA and deployed provider validation remain separate.
